title: A layer cake
checked: Every reachable state checked (7 states, 12 with their data, 12 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 7 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: Each layer goes on a set layer
rules.says: A sponge is cold, and jam or cream has set, before the next layer goes on it.
rules.path: Take away the layer below is set guard and it breaks in 2 steps: add a layer, add a layer.

rules.says: The icing goes on only when all five layers are on the board and the top one is cold.
rules.path: Take away the top is set guard and it breaks in 10 steps: add a layer, wait to set, add a layer, wait to set, add a layer, wait to set, add a layer, wait to set, add a layer, ice it.
